description: This file is a shell script that contains test setup code for testing tail optimization in a shell scripting context. It defines functions for generating large strings and performing pattern substitutions, sets up test cases with specific input data, and checks the output against expected results.

methods.name: zs
methods.description: Generates a repeated string based on a count, optimized for large counts by subtracting large blocks.

methods.name: zc
methods.description: Performs a series of sed substitution operations to replace repeated patterns with shorter forms, used to verify diff outputs.

methods.name: expect_pattern
methods.description: Generates expected diff output patterns for given test inputs to validate the diff between file sets.
